item.title: No. 4 Arizona bounces back from first 2 losses of the season, beats No. 23 BYU 75-68
item.description: Anthony Dell'Orso scored a season-high 22 points after coming off the bench, Ivan Kharchenkov added 18 and No. 4 Arizona bounced back from its first two losses of the season by beating No. 23 BYU 75-68.

item.title: No. 14 Virginia routs Georgia Tech 94-68 for 8th straight road win
item.description: Thijs De Ridder scored 22 points, Malik Thomas added 17 and No. 14 Virginia won its seventh straight game and eighth in a row on the road, beating Georgia Tech 94-68 on Wednesday night.

item.title: Asian shares advance, tracking a Wall St rally led by Nvidia
item.description: Asian shares are higher after U.S. stocks advanced, led by computer chip giant Nvidia.

item.title: St. John's beats Marquette to win 12th straight game, takes over Big East lead
item.description: Bryce Hopkins had 23 points and 10 rebounds for No. 17 St. John's in Milwaukee.

item.title: Hubbard hits program-record 10 3s, scores 46 as Mississippi State blows big lead, beats Auburn
item.description: Josh Hubbard made a program-record 10 3-pointers and scored a career-high 46 points as Mississippi State blew an 18-point lead and then rallied to beat Auburn 91-85.

item.title: Snow drought helped set the stage for deadly California avalanche, leading to unstable conditions
item.description: Experts say a weekslong "snow drought" in Norther California's Sierra Nevada helped set the stage for Tuesday's deadly avalanche, after several feet of new snow fell on an earlier layer that had hardened.

item.title: Jurors deliberations to start in trial over killings of 4 men as they slept on NYC streets
item.description: Jurors are set to start deliberating Thursday in the trial of a man who fatally beat four men as they slept on New York City's streets.

item.title: Darius Acuff Jr. scores 49 points against Alabama and nearly delivers in OT for Arkansas
item.description: Darius Acuff Jr. nearly delivered No. 20 Arkansas a stunning victory in double overtime on a night when the Razorbacks were down to a seven-man rotation against 25th-ranked Alabama.

item.title: Genealogical sites have helped solve major crimes. Police in Nancy Guthrie's case might turn to them
item.description: Authorities trying to solve the disappearance of Nancy Guthrie say they might tap DNA genealogy databases.
